purpose: Reconstruction and integrity blueprint for the HowlRex project.

layers.5_reconstruction: This manifest plus project history and media references allow the project to be rebuilt when source files are damaged or missing.

policy: When the user mentions Howl Rex, use the available project context and repository history to continue assistance. No system can honestly guarantee that an external service or administrator can never delete data; independent backups outside a single service are required for true disaster resistance.
